clause: Preflight rule categories + structured findings to command surface [STU-LAY-057]

scope.summary: Author the enumerable, normative preflight rule categories over the MT-182 engine: Links/resources (missing links, modified links, low placed-image DPI, outdated linked resources, passthrough compatibility); Color (blend space, allowed plates, allowed color spaces, overprint, rich-black violations, CMY-in-gray, mismatched RGB spaces); Ink (ink density over threshold for fills/strokes/text); Images & objects (resolution, transparency/rasterization-forcing effects, minimum stroke weight, non-proportional scaling, hidden objects, bleed-zone hazards); Text (missing fonts, missing characters, overset text, spelling, text patterns — double spaces, straight quotes, double hyphens); Document (page size, page count, blank pages, bleed/slug); Accessibility/data (missing alt text, stale data-merge sources, out-of-date TOC, unnamed anchors, invalid hyperlinks, stale cross-references). Preflight rules MUST be surfaced to the model-steerable command surface as structured findings, not only to the operator UI.
acceptance_criteria: all seven preflight rule categories fire + findings exposed as structured model-steerable output
proof_targets: per-category rule-fire runtime; structured-findings command test
expected_tests: live: representative rule from each of the seven categories fires on a crafted document (missing link, ink over-limit, overset text, missing alt text, stale cross-ref)
test: findings returned to model-steerable command surface as structured codes, not UI-only

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Preflight rule categories

risk_if_missed: Preflight has no rules; models cannot consume findings; output defects undetected.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
